attchmntText: Indiabulls Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32

attchmntText: In terms of Regulation 32 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, please find attached report of Monitoring Agency (Acuite Ratings and Research Limited) confirming no deviation in the utilization of proceeds of funds raised by Indiabulls Limited (formerly Yaari Digital Integrated Services Limited) (the  Company ), through preferential issue of convertible warrants, during the quarter ended September 30, 2026.The above-mentioned Report, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, which is self-explanatory and was placed before the Audit Committee of the Company, at its meeting held today i.e. November 5, 2026, wherein the Committee has noted the same and approved for submission with Stock Exchanges, without any comment.Please take the aforesaid intimation on record.

Indiabulls Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of Board Meeting of Indiabulls Limited ( the Company ) held on November 5, 2026 and disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'.

Indiabulls Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 05, 2026, titled "Press Release w.r.t the Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
Indiabulls Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Earning Update for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026'.
Indiabulls Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
